events.title: Threat Brief: NetScaler Zero Days CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 Exploited in the Wild (Updated September 30)
events.summary: Citrix NetScaler devices were compromised by two zero‑day vulnerabilities, CVE‑2026‑88771 and CVE‑2026‑88772, which have already been exploited in the wild.
events.why_it_matters: Both vulnerabilities have a CVSS score of 9.5 and are listed on the KEV, underscoring their severity and the fact that they are actively exploited.

reasons: published by an Australian government authority (ACSC Alerts)

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 as exploited in the wild.
CVE-2026-88772 is rated 9.5 (critical) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it, the highest of the 8 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-88772 being exploited in the next 30 days at 1.3%, the highest of the 8 CVEs here.
